Each answer carries the vendor’s verbatim quote and its page (35.an-4); "no" only with a quote saying it is not offered, silence is not_mentioned (35.ao-7). monthly_minor is MINOR units, converted from the page’s amount with lib/money-format.ts toMinorUnits (the 100× guard). request_check sets check_requested_at.
